name: SO/ Bangkok
short_description: A design-forward 237-room lifestyle hotel at Sathorn and Rama IV, overlooking Lumpini Park, with rooms designed around the elements and a landmark rooftop pool.
ai_summary: SO/ Bangkok occupies a 30-storey glass tower at the crossroads of North Sathorn and Rama IV roads, overlooking Lumpini Park and the city skyline, a short walk from Lumpini MRT station. Each of the 237 rooms and suites is designed around one of five elements by French designer Christian Lacroix and other collaborators, and the rooftop pool and bar are frequently singled out as one of the best in Bangkok. Guests consistently praise the striking design, helpful staff, and pool, though some reviewers note the hotel prioritizes design over practicality in places, and a handful describe wear -- stained walls, cracked flooring -- that feels inconsistent with a five-star property.

faqs.question: What is the design concept behind SO/ Bangkok's rooms?
faqs.answer: Each of the 237 rooms and suites is designed around one of five elements, a concept developed with French designer Christian Lacroix and other collaborators -- part of what makes the hotel one of Bangkok's more design-forward five-star properties.

faqs.question: Is SO/ Bangkok near Lumpini Park?
faqs.answer: Yes -- it sits at the crossroads of North Sathorn and Rama IV roads directly overlooking Lumpini Park, within a short walk of Lumpini MRT station, putting Bangkok's largest downtown green space right outside.
